# Olga's Luxury Villa

> A privately owned 3-bedroom holiday villa in Kontrakia, Corfu, Greece, with a
> private infinity pool and panoramic views over the Ionian Sea, Gouvia Marina
> and Corfu Town. It sleeps 6 and is bookable directly with the owner.

This file summarises the key facts about a single property so they can be read
without parsing the page. Everything here is also stated in plain text on the
website itself. Source of truth: https://olgasluxuryvilla-corfu.com/

## The property

- Name: Olga's Luxury Villa
- Type: Private holiday villa / vacation rental (whole property, not shared)
- Location: Kontrakia, Corfu 49100, Ionian Islands, Greece
- Coordinates: 39.6347, 19.8673
- Sleeps: 6 guests
- Bedrooms: 3
- Bathrooms: 2.5 (two full bathrooms, one ground-floor guest WC)
- Indicative rate: from EUR 499 per night, varying by season and length of stay
- Check-in from 15:00, check-out by 11:00
- Minimum stay: 4 nights
- Beds: 1 king, 2 queen, plus a sofa bed
- Pets: not accepted

## Amenities

- Private infinity pool with sea views and sun loungers
- Panoramic views of Corfu Town, the Ionian Sea and Gouvia Marina
- Outdoor BBQ and dining area
- Multiple balconies and terraces
- Fully equipped kitchen and indoor dining area
- Air conditioning throughout
- High-speed Wi-Fi, and a desk area for working
- Private on-site parking, free of charge
- Washing machine, tumble dryer and dishwasher
- Cot and high chair available for young children
- Pool is not heated

## Included in the rate

- Bed linen, bath towels and pool towels
- Final clean and a mid-stay clean
- Wi-Fi, air conditioning and parking

## Distances

- Corfu Town (UNESCO Old Town): about 6 km, roughly 10 minutes by car
- Corfu Airport (CFU): about 15 minutes by car
- Kontokali Beach: about 5 minutes by car
- Gouvia Marina: about 5 minutes by car
- Dassia Beach: about 10 minutes by car
- Nearest bus stop: about 100 m on foot, though a hire car is recommended

- Direct enquiry: https://olgasluxuryvilla-corfu.com/#contact
- Booking direct avoids the platform service fee, typically 15% or more
- Email: olgasluxuryvilla.corfu@gmail.com
